item.title: Cooking With Care at Carrozza
item.description: In downtown Edenton, a new restaurant shines with dishes inspired by local ingredients and a mother’s love.

item.description: A new coffee shop brings flavor, quality, and heart to downtown Wilkesboro.

item.description: A new burrito spot in Durham rolls up Southwestern breakfast favorites.

item.title: Moore Memories: A Visual Arts-Inspired Weekend in Moore County

item.title: Fireflies, Bonfires, and Stargazing: 12 Ways to Celebrate Nightlife in Graham County
item.description: Mountain fun and adventures don’t have to stop when the sun sets.

item.title: Family Branches
item.description: At Friendswood Brooms in Leicester, the craft of broom making is passed down, hand to handle, through generations.

item.title: What Does North Carolina Smell Like?
item.description: From woodsmoke to salt air, certain scents carry memory, tradition, and comfort across North Carolina.

item.title: 6 Small-Batch Soapmakers
item.description: From Canton to the Outer Banks, these artisans use local ingredients — from Ocracoke figs to Foothills moonshine — and foolproof family recipes to make every scrub, soak, and lather feel like home.

item.title: Daffodil Cake
item.description: A cake first made in Depression-era kitchens using household staples now helps us savor the season, no green thumb necessary.
